_comment: Declaring a board model before its hardware exists. A type describes a model, not a board on the bus - and naming the wrong firmware family for one is refused up front, naming the known families. An undeclared family has no ~/<name> fallback: firmware.resolve and the save-time revalidation both raise ConfigCorruptError with missing_section_message, a generic config_corrupt rather than a refusal listing what is known.

mutations.name: an undeclared family is refused when a type is created
a type is created with the family it asked for
swapping the source tree warns that provenance cannot see it
an edited firmware family is actually stored
